title: SvgAnimateTransform
responsibility: Renders the native animateTransform element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgAnimateTransform.attributes
inputs.description: Native animateTransform attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgAnimateTransform.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native animateTransform element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgAnimateTransform
outputs.description: The actual native animateTransform element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
